name: Package Diagram
description: Package Diagram describes how packages/modules/source folders are organized and their dependencies. This diagram helps control source code structure, architectural layering, and circular dependencies.
purpose: Plan directory/package structure, control circular dependencies, design layered architecture.
bestFor: Plan directory structure when starting a project
Design layered architecture (Presentation, Business, Data Access)
notSuitableFor: Describe services/components with runtime interfaces → use Component Diagram
Describe detailed classes → use Class Diagram
Describe deployment infrastructure → use Deployment Diagram
requirements: Packages — groups of logically related classes/interfaces

confusableWith.difference: Package leans toward source code organization; Component leans toward deployable/runtime component.
Package Diagram groups classes; Class Diagram describes classes and their relationships in detail.
